Supporting: the State Parks boundary layer returns 'Forks of the Sky, State Park Property' at this wall's catalog point (47.8191,-121.5719), and the county parcel there is owned by Washington State Parks; the WCC planning page says most of the Index climbing area lies in Forks of the Sky. Against copying: the catalog point is Mountain Project's own GPS (not evidence), no independent source (OSM has no crag mapped; theCrag Forbidden) places the wall, and the ownership around it is a patchwork: a BNSF parcel ~100 m south-west, a federal (U S A) parcel ~125 m east, and private parcels ~150 m north-west. Baker-Snoqualmie NF, Northwest Forest Pass, a Mount Rainier NP fee line and a note about Persis/Gunn/Baring peaks) is wrong on its fees and notes lines either way. Owner choice: copy the State Parks object, or access -> null.
